Managed Detection & Response (MDR)






MDR protects your assets with 24x7 cyber security detection and response















Our team of security experts monitor, detect and respond to threats targeting your business - 24/7 


















mnemonic’s Managed Detection and Response (MDR) delivers 24/7 threat detection and rapid response across cloud, endpoint, network, and OT environments. Our security experts work as an extension of your team, integrating directly into your technology stack to stop threats before they disrupt your business. 

With flexible Core , Advanced , and Enterprise plans, mnemonic MDR security scales to match your security needs and operational complexity. 















mnemonic MDR for Microsoft Defender XDR and Microsoft Sentinel combines mnemonic’s advanced MDR solution with Microsoft’s Defender XDR, creating a seamless security solution tailored for organisations using Microsoft’s security services. 

This integration enables efficient detection, investigation, and remediation of security threats across networks, endpoints, email and identities - all within the familiar Microsoft environment. 















At the core of our MDR services is Argus - our purpose-built ecosystem to rapidly detect, analyse and respond to security threats on a colossal scale. 

Taking advantage of big data analytics, machine learning, and a complex event-processing framework, Argus provides the advanced threat prevention ecosystem needed to see the big threat picture in real-time and protect our customers against advanced persistent threats, zero days and targeted attacks. 












From the mnemonic Security Operations Center (SOC), our expert team of threat investigators, incident handlers, and ethical hackers, combined with the maturity of our Argus security platform provide us with the necessary capacity, skillset and technology to handle complex security incidents. 

This unique combination allows us to stay ahead of advanced attacks, protect our customers from new threats, and be the trusted security partner for our customers.
